summary_1line: Durvasa arrives urgently at Rama’s palace while Rama speaks with Death, and Lakshmana tries to delay the notoriously irascible sage.

image_candidates.scene_text: The fierce sage Durvasa stands at Rama’s palace gate glaring at Lakshmana, his matted hair wild as the guard bows and tries to restrain him.
Inside the palace, Rama calmly converses with the personified Death while divine light fills the chamber.
